chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The divorce of a woman when she is with a slave is three divorces, and when she is a slave under a free man, then two divorces.
ai.seo_question: How many divorces are required to finalize a divorce when a free woman is married to a slave or vice versa?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the jurisprudential distinction in revocable divorces (raj'i) based on the social status of the spouses, reflecting the legal realities of early Islamic society. It establishes that a free woman under a slave husband requires three talaqs to finalize the divorce, whereas a slave woman under a free husband requires only two, highlighting the nuanced application of family law in Shia fiqh.
